_comment: PRODUCTION stage 2 (autoregressive fine-tune) - loads stage-1 best.ckpt (best val_loss,
published by src/main.py only when stage 1 finished, i.e. wrote COMPLETED; EMA weights
preferred automatically by the weights_only loader).
Model block is IDENTICAL to stage 1.
Default rollout-gradient mode is full BPTT with uniform per-step weighting, chosen on the
literature prior (GraphCast and NeuralGCM state BPTT). E4 local evidence mixed: detached better
on the geometric metric, BPTT better on fixed-dt; unresolved at 2-3 seeds.
FALLBACK (lower memory; the best local geometric point estimate, but the sandbox used skip 2
and this recipe keeps skip 1, smoke-tested only): under training.autoregressive_training set
"detach_between_steps": true,
"backward_per_step": true,
"loss_discount_gamma": 0.9   <- REQUIRED with detach (E3; not enforced in code)
keeping skip_steps 1 and training.curriculum 2->10, and set training.loss.jump_weight 0.0 (the detached
rollout does not add the long-jump term; src/trainer.py refuses the pair). Write the nested keys: a
dotted key such as "autoregressive_training.loss_discount_gamma" is rejected at startup.
docs/DECISIONS.md: per-key evidence, and the Inherited / unjustified table for values without it.
Schedule: recipe R (author decision 2026-10-01; docs/DECISIONS.md): fixed step budgets, not derived from the
data size. 20,000-step epochs; 1-epoch LR warmup; curriculum 2->10 over 16 epochs (K up by 1 every 2);
plateau patience 5; early-stopping patience 12; at most 120 epochs (2.4M steps). Both monitors start
counting at the first epoch after the warmup and the ramp (epoch 16). If the epoch length changes,
re-derive every epoch-counted knob from its step target.
Peak LR at the handoff: min(training.optimizer.lr, the LR saved in the loaded stage-1 checkpoint)
(src/main.py; logged and recorded in provenance.jsonl); a resume keeps it.
Stage 2 reuses the stage-1 processed shards; do NOT rerun preprocessing.
Run: AUTOCHEM_CONFIG_PATH=configs/stage2.json python -u src/main.py

precision._comment: amp_mode "true" = Lightning 32-true: no autocast (required for float32 compute); only "mixed" enables autocast. TF32 is allow_tf32 (forced off by runtime.deterministic=true).

_comment: Identical to stage 1 EXCEPT overwrite=false, the sole intended difference:
stage 2 reuses the same processed shards (../data/processed); do NOT rerun
preprocessing for stage 2 (overwrite=false is the guard).

dataset._comment: Epoch by count, a fixed step budget: 20000 optimizer steps per epoch and a fixed validation set of 2621440 = 1280 x 2048 windows (no ragged last batch; 10 or 11 even-stride starts per validation trajectory of the 4-file build, N_val 256734 after the frozen-tail cut, 257704 before). Not re-derived when data is added.

_comment: Long-jump term: every step adds jump_weight * HybridLoss(F(z(t), D), z(t + D)) on jump_batch_size pairs from
<processed_dir>/raw_trajectories (written by preprocessing), D log-uniform in [jump_min_seconds,
jump_max_seconds] s and t log-uniform where t + D stays inside the trajectory. D runs past dt_max (1000 s):
the relaxation head's network never sees dt.
